title: Quick Braised Vietnamese Pork Chops Curry
description: A malty, flaky, monsoon Vietnamese dish featuring pork chops, kombu-cold-extract, made paleo-friendly in a kadhai vessel
instructions: Soak the kombu sheets in cold water for 30 minutes to make the kombu-cold-extract.
In a blender, combine the soaked kombu, curry powder, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth.
Heat a kadhai over medium heat and add the blended mixture, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add the pork chops to the kadhai and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until browned.
Add the coconut milk to the kadhai and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
